method: Hand-written single-best-answer MCQs grounded only in the accepted open full text.

topic.topicDisplayName: Rituximab in rheumatic disease: dosing, pre-treatment screening, hypogammaglobulinaemia
topic.coverageNote: Screening and hypogammaglobulinemia are explicit. A separate hypogammaglobulinemia cohort used a 2×1 g then 1 g every 6 months schedule; that dosing schedule is not imported into this paper's MCQs.

mcqs.question: In the pooled trial analysis, how did low IgM change across rituximab cycles?

options.A: 10.3% at week 24, 18.5% after a second cycle, and 23.5% after a third
options.E: Low IgM occurred only before the first dose

mcqs.correctAnswerText: 10.3% at week 24, 18.5% after a second cycle, and 23.5% after a third
mcqs.explanation: Low IgM was 10.3% at week 24, 18.5% with a second cycle, and 23.5% after a third cycle.

sourceRefs.excerpt: 10.3% had a low IgM at week 24, but this increased to 18.5% with a second cycle and 23.5% after a third cycle of therapy

mcqs.question: What happened to low IgG across those cycles?

options.A: 1.5% at week 24, then 4.3% and 5.9% with subsequent cycles
options.B: IgG deficiency was universal after one dose
options.D: IgG was an exclusion that never occurred on treatment
options.E: IgG was lower than IgM at every time point in the opposite direction of the text

mcqs.correctAnswerText: 1.5% at week 24, then 4.3% and 5.9% with subsequent cycles
mcqs.explanation: Low IgG was 1.5% at week 24 and 4.3% then 5.9% with subsequent cycles. The review notes low immunoglobulins were observed, IgM more than IgG.

sourceRefs.excerpt: 1.5% had a low IgG at week 24; 4.3% and 5.9% with subsequent cycles of therapy.

mcqs.question: What pre-treatment immunoglobulin action does the review recommend?

options.A: Measure immunoglobulin levels; if hypogammaglobulinemia is already present, use rituximab with caution or avoid it
options.B: Immunoglobulins are irrelevant because plasma cells are untouched
options.C: Give intravenous immunoglobulin to every patient before the first dose
options.E: Defer immunoglobulin testing until after the third cycle

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Measure immunoglobulin levels; if hypogammaglobulinemia is already present, use rituximab with caution or avoid it
mcqs.explanation: Immunoglobulins should be measured because low IgG is associated with higher infection risk, and existing hypogammaglobulinemia warrants caution or avoidance.

mcqs.question: Which viral serologies are required before rituximab, and why?

options.A: Hepatitis B and C, because HBsAg-negative, anti-HBc-positive hepatitis B reactivation has rarely been reported
options.B: Only HIV, because hepatitis B is unaffected

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Hepatitis B and C, because HBsAg-negative, anti-HBc-positive hepatitis B reactivation has rarely been reported
mcqs.explanation: Hepatitis B and C serologies should be done because reactivation of HBsAg-negative, hepatitis B core-antibody-positive disease has rarely been reported.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Hepatitis B and C serologies should be undertaken, because reactivation of hepatitis B surface Ag negative but hepatitis B core Ab positive disease has been rarely reported

mcqs.question: Who should consider hepatitis B vaccination before rituximab?

options.A: Patients negative for both HBsAg and anti-HBc
options.B: Patients with active HBsAg-positive hepatitis, as the only step
options.C: Everyone, including those already anti-HBs positive from vaccination is not the group specified
options.D: No one, because rituximab improves vaccine responses

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Patients negative for both HBsAg and anti-HBc
mcqs.explanation: Patients who are HBsAg-negative and anti-HBc-negative should consider vaccination before rituximab. Those who are HBsAg and/or anti-HBc positive need evaluation before treatment rather than routine vaccination alone.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Those patients who are HBsAg and anti-HBc negative should consider vaccination before rituximab is initiated
